_comment_pred_dir: Folder containing raw prediction XDMF files for one model run.
_comment_dataset_dir: Folder containing dataset truth XDMFs used to inject levelset when absent in predictions.
_comment_configs_pool: Pickle file with per-case metadata (case id, geometry, Reynolds).
_comment_model_name: Model identifier used for output folder naming under output_dir/model_name.
_comment_model_shortname: Short name for legends in single-model and comparison plots. If not set, falls back to nickname or model_name.
_comment_output_dir: Root directory where postprocessing outputs are written.
_comment_prediction_base_name: Filename prefix for prediction XDMF files (e.g. 'graph_' -> 'graph_10000.xdmf').
_comment_feature_map: Mapping from x* channels in prediction XDMF to semantic meaning. x0/x1/x2 are expected to be velocity_x/velocity_y/pressure.
_comment_target_map: Mapping from y* channels to target semantics. Used for shifted target alignment.
_comment_target_step_offset: Number of steps by which targets lead predictions (usually 1).
_comment_rollout_steps: Optional rollout cap (integer) or null for full rollout. Limits time-series extraction and all downstream computations.
_comment_sensor_mode: Sensor placement mode: 'auto' (from configs_pool geometry) or 'csv' (from sensor_csv file).
_comment_sensor_csv: CSV file with sensor_id, x, y columns. Used only when sensor_mode is 'csv'.
_comment_sensor_drop_last_column: If true, uses 3x2 sensor layout (6 panels total) instead of 3x3 (9 panels). Default false.
_comment_levelset_source: Source for levelset field: 'prediction' (if x* includes levelset) or 'dataset' (inject from dataset_dir truth files).
_comment_force_mu: Fluid viscosity for force integration. Default 1e-3 (Re ~ 1000 scale).
_comment_force_workers: Number of parallel workers for force computation. Default 4.
_comment_force_sign_factor: Sign multiplier applied to all force components (Fx, Fy). Default -1.0 to ensure Fx > 0 convention.
